forms_instance_not_found: The instance "{name}" does not exist in .jgates/tools.yml.
forms_not_found: The adapter {adapter} has no form; its configuration is edited as text.
forms_not_found_fix: Use the Files tab to edit the configuration file.
forms_no_document: The instance {instance} has no bound file that the form knows how to edit.
forms_no_document_fix: Bind one of these files in .jgates/tools.yml: {files}.
forms_unavailable_missing: The file {file} does not exist; create it in the Files tab.
forms_unavailable_not_text: The file {file} cannot be read as text.
forms_unavailable_format: There is no structured reading for the format {format}; text editing continues.
forms_unavailable_parse: The file has a syntax error, and the form stays suspended until it is fixed: {detail}
forms_unavailable_section: The section {section} is not a table; fix it in the text.
forms_unavailable_fix: Edit the file in the Files tab.
forms_read_only: The file {file} cannot be written by the form: {reason}.
forms_field_unknown: The field {field} is not part of this form.
forms_field_unknown_fix: Reload the form; fields outside it are edited as text.
forms_field_unrecognized: The value of {field} is not recognized by the form, which neither changes nor removes it.
forms_field_unrecognized_fix: Edit that field in the text (line {line}).
forms_value_invalid_fix: Fix the value and review again.
forms_patch_failed: Could not compute the minimal change to the file: {detail}
forms_problem_parent: {path} is not a table in the file.
forms_ruff_line_length_help: Column limit used by lint (E501) and by formatting.
forms_ruff_target_version_help: Version the code is checked and formatted for. Inherited from requires-python when absent.
forms_ruff_include_help: Glob patterns of the files Ruff analyzes.
forms_ruff_exclude_help: Glob patterns that replace Ruff's default exclusion list.
forms_ruff_extend_exclude_help: Glob patterns added to the default exclusions.
forms_ruff_src_help: Directories used to classify imports as first-party or third-party.
forms_ruff_preview_help: Enables unstable Ruff rules and behaviours.
forms_ruff_fix_help: Applies safe fixes when running Ruff outside JGates (JGates does not change the code).
forms_ruff_required_version_help: Range of Ruff versions accepted by this configuration.
forms_ruff_lint_select_help: Codes or prefixes of enabled rules (for example E, F, B, UP or F401).
forms_ruff_lint_ignore_help: Codes or prefixes of disabled rules.
forms_ruff_lint_extend_select_help: Rules added to the selection, without replacing it.
forms_ruff_lint_per_file_ignores_help: For each glob pattern, the rules ignored in the files it covers.
forms_ruff_lint_fixable_help: Rules whose fixes may be applied.
forms_ruff_lint_unfixable_help: Rules whose fixes are never applied.
forms_ruff_lint_dummy_variable_rgx_help: Regular expression of the variable names that may stay unused.
forms_ruff_lint_preview_help: Enables the preview rules for lint only.
forms_ruff_format_skip_magic_trailing_co: Does not use the trailing comma to keep a collection on several lines.
forms_ruff_format_docstring_code_format_: Formats the code examples inside docstrings.
forms_ruff_format_exclude_help: Glob patterns that formatting does not touch.
forms_pytest_testpaths_help: Where pytest looks for tests when no path is given.
forms_pytest_addopts_help: Arguments added to every pytest call.
forms_pytest_minversion_help: pytest refuses to run with an older version.
forms_pytest_markers_help: Registered markers, one per item (name: description).
forms_pytest_xfail_strict_help: A test marked xfail that passes counts as a failure.
forms_pytest_python_files_help: Glob patterns of the test modules.
forms_pytest_python_classes_help: Prefixes of the class names collected as tests.
forms_pytest_python_functions_help: Prefixes of the function names collected as tests.
forms_pytest_norecursedirs_help: Directory patterns collection does not enter.
forms_pytest_pythonpath_help: Directories added to sys.path during the tests.
forms_pytest_filterwarnings_help: Filters applied in order; the last ones take precedence.
forms_pytest_required_plugins_help: Plugins that must be installed for pytest to run.
forms_pytest_empty_parameter_set_mark_he: What to do with a parametrize that has no values.
forms_pytest_console_output_style_help: How progress shows in the terminal.
forms_pytest_log_cli_help: Shows the logs during the run.
forms_pytest_log_cli_level_help: Minimum level of the logs shown.
forms_pytest_junit_family_help: Variant of the JUnit XML report.
